_comment: Policy B: tuned to the quality-report of facility 3, 2026-10-16 (584 labeled faces, buffalo_l). Gentle, monotone ramps on the measures that separated genuine from impostor pairs; no term can veto a typical CCTV face. Residual (strongest signal) is back as a SOFT penalty (0.1.0 zeroed it at 6 px); asymmetry is off because it largely repeats the residual; yaw vetoes only true profiles. Compare with A through quality-report and eval before using it.
